cause_quote: The new `readVerifiedArtifactSource` threw `new ClawHubSourceError("clawhub_manifest_invalid", "Downloaded Claw package manifest is invalid.")` when `loaded.ok` was false, discarding `loaded.diagnostics`.
user_saw: When users tried to add a ClawHub Template with an invalid manifest, the CLI and Control UI reported that the manifest was invalid without saying why.
summary: The fix adds up to three sanitized, package-relative manifest diagnostics to the error and reports how many were omitted.
reasoning: The Add feature reintroduced a previously removed ClawHub source resolver and wired Add planning to it with the generic error already present. The later Claws-to-Templates rename changed the wording to “Template” and preserved the branch that discarded the diagnostics.
